text:
Type: woven seagrass floor basket
Use: storing throws, pillows or plants; living room, bedroom, home office, on the floor
Style: modern, bohemian, glam
Materials: woven seagrass, gold metal wire inset
Colors: black, gold
Shape: round slightly tapered drum, thick wrapped rim, open V-shaped cut-out with leaf-vein wire pattern, large
Feel: bold, textured, striking
Goes with: white walls, brass accents, dark wood, plants; modern or boho rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Woven Seagrass Storage Organizer Basket - 16 Inch, Black & Gold
product.description: This mixed-media basket will add modern style to your room. It provides handy storage for blankets, throws, magazines, or anything else you need to neatly contain on the floor or on a shelf. Dyed seagrass has accents of gold for a striking contrast. 15.7" Diameter x 16.1" H Use on a shelf to conceal items, or to display items on a tabletop or on the floor Dyed seagrass and metal mesh with diagonal metal accents on the side Even when it's empty, this piece will adds modern style with a touch of glam
